PlatformSettings.title: PlatformSettings
PlatformSettings.description: Global platform configuration controlled by the verified Platform Admin, including brokerage commission, escrow fee, promotional discount, live FX rates, broadcast banner, master switches, and removed showcase IDs.

commissionRatePct.description: Default/fallback one-time brokerage commission percentage (1 to 50).

familyApartmentCommissionPct.description: Dedicated brokerage commission percentage for Family Apartments (1 to 50).

hotelRoomCommissionPct.description: Dedicated brokerage commission percentage for Hotel Rooms (1 to 50).

industrialFactoryCommissionPct.description: Dedicated brokerage commission percentage for Industrial Factories (1 to 50).

studentHousingCommissionPct.description: Dedicated brokerage commission percentage for Student Housing (1 to 50).

wholeHouseCommissionPct.description: Dedicated brokerage commission percentage for Whole House rentals (1 to 50).

commissionModel.description: Brokerage fee charging model (charged once at contract signing).

escrowProtectionFeePct.description: Optional escrow service protection fee percentage (0 to 25).

tenantDiscountPct.description: Optional global promotional discount percentage announced to tenants (0 to 50).

usdRateEgp.description: Optional live exchange rate for 1 USD in EGP (1 to 1000).

sarRateEgp.description: Optional live exchange rate for 1 SAR in EGP (1 to 1000).

eurRateEgp.description: Optional live exchange rate for 1 EUR in EGP (1 to 1000).

aedRateEgp.description: Optional live exchange rate for 1 AED in EGP (1 to 1000).

announcementText.description: Optional live global announcement banner text shown immediately on user pages.

allowNewListings.description: Optional master switch allowing or pausing new property listings.

allowNewBookings.description: Optional master switch allowing or pausing new bookings and rental requests.

removedShowcaseIds.description: Bounded list (max 50) of removed showcase apartment IDs hidden across all user views.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the platform admin who updated the setting.

Apartment.title: Apartment
Apartment.description: Publicly listed real-estate unit across Egyptian governorates categorized into Family Apartments, Student Housing, Hotel Rooms (daily or monthly), and Industrial Factories, with optional base currency and 360-degree virtual tours. Deleted atomically upon rental.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the landlord.

ownerDisplayName.description: Public display name of the landlord.

category.description: Primary sector classification of the property, including Whole House rentals.

billingMode.description: Whether the unit is rented monthly only or supports daily/monthly stays (hotels and whole houses).

baseCurrency.description: Landlord's chosen base currency when listing the unit.

baseMonthlyPrice.description: Monthly rent expressed in the chosen baseCurrency.

baseDailyPrice.description: Daily stay rate expressed in the chosen baseCurrency.

baseStudentBedPrice.description: Student bed monthly rate expressed in the chosen baseCurrency.

dailyRateEgp.description: Daily stay rate in EGP for hotel rooms (0 when monthly_only).

studentBedsCount.description: Available student beds count when student rental is offered (0 if family/commercial only).

studentPricePerBedEgp.description: Monthly rent per student bed in EGP, separate from family rent.

houseApartmentsCount.description: Number of residential apartments contained inside a whole-house listing (1 to 60).

houseFloorsCount.description: Number of building floors in a whole-house listing (1 to 20).

houseHasGardenOrRoof.description: Whether the whole house includes a private garden, courtyard, or rooftop terrace.

houseHasPrivateGarage.description: Whether the whole house includes dedicated private parking or garage.

houseSpecsSummary.description: Detailed building specifications for a whole-house listing (meters, entrances, finishing).

title.description: Listing headline in Arabic or English.

description.description: Detailed unit specifications and neighborhood notes.

district.description: City, industrial zone, or neighborhood district.

bedrooms.description: Number of rooms/bedrooms (0 allowed for open-plan factories).

areaSqm.description: Unit area in square meters (18 to 100000).

imageKey.description: Curated verified architectural photo asset identifier.

hasVirtualTour.description: Whether the unit includes an interactive 360-degree virtual tour or panorama.

panorama360DataUrl.description: Client-compressed 360-degree equirectangular JPEG data URL uploaded by the landlord.

virtualTourUrl.description: Optional external HTTPS 360-degree virtual tour link.

commissionRatePct.description: Active one-time platform brokerage commission percentage at listing time.

mandateAccepted.description: Confirmation of signed exclusive brokerage mandate.

LegalDossier.title: LegalDossier
LegalDossier.description: Isolated PII legal ownership verification documents and signed brokerage commission contract.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the landlord.

ownerPhone.description: Egyptian mobile number isolated from public scraping.

exactAddress.description: Private building, floor, or plot number.

propertyRegistryNumber.description: Real Estate Publicity Department (Shahr Aqari) or industrial license ref.

titleDeedSha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of ownership contract.

utilityBillSha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of utility bill.

ownerIbanOrInstapay.description: Payout destination for the landlord's net share.

digitalSignatureName.description: Full legal Arabic name signed on the mandate.

exclusivityClauseAccepted.description: Acceptance of non-circumvention and one-time brokerage commission deduction.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of legal dossier submission.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Escrow rental contract enforcing one-time brokerage commission deduction, multi-currency FX snapshot, and atomic property deletion.

district.description: Optional snapshot of neighborhood or district.

lat.description: Optional snapshot of property latitude inside Egypt (22.0 to 31.8).

lng.description: Optional snapshot of property longitude inside Egypt (24.5 to 37.0).

landlordDisplayName.description: Public display name snapshot of landlord.

rentalUnit.description: Billing unit selected for the booking.

unitPriceEgp.description: Base rate per period (1 month, 1 day, or N student beds for 1 month).

unitsCount.description: Number of months or days booked (1 to 365).

bedsBooked.description: Number of student beds booked (0 when not student_bed).

monthlyRentEgp.description: Snapshot of unit monthly rent in EGP.

commissionRatePct.description: Active one-time brokerage commission percentage applied at contract signing.

totalRentEgp.description: Total contract value paid into escrow (unitPriceEgp * unitsCount).

platformCommissionEgp.description: One-time brokerage commission locked once at source ((unitPriceEgp * commissionRatePct) / 100).

exchangeRateToEgp.description: Reference exchange rate from 1 unit of paymentCurrency to EGP.

paidAmountInCurrency.description: Total contract amount converted into paymentCurrency.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Verified tenant rating and text review permanently tied to the landlord's account.

bookingId.description: Verified booking ID (1-to-1 with review document ID).

landlordId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the landlord's account.

landlordDisplayName.description: Public display name of the landlord.

tenantId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reviewing tenant.

tenantDisplayName.description: Public display name of the reviewing tenant.

rating.description: Unit quality and accuracy star rating (1 to 5).

landlordRating.description: Landlord account honesty and handover rating (1 to 5).

landlordVerdict.description: Tenant verdict on whether the landlord's account is trustworthy.

comment.description: Written tenant review describing their experience.

visibilityStatus.description: Moderation visibility status for public queries.

Favorite.title: Favorite
Favorite.description: User-saved favorite property bookmark storing public listing snapshot metadata and optional price-drop alert subscription with zero PII.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who saved the unit.

dailyRateEgp.description: Snapshot of daily stay rate in EGP if applicable.

monthlyRentEgp.description: Snapshot of monthly rent in Egyptian Pounds.

studentPricePerBedEgp.description: Snapshot of student bed monthly price.

priceAlertEnabled.description: Whether the user opted in to receive notifications if daily or monthly rent drops.

baselineMonthlyRentEgp.description: Baseline monthly rent in EGP recorded when watching for price drops.

baselineDailyRateEgp.description: Baseline daily rate in EGP recorded when watching for price drops.

lastAlertedRentEgp.description: Most recent discounted rent in EGP for which an alert was dispatched.

areaSqm.description: Snapshot of area in square meters.

imageKey.description: Snapshot of verified architectural image identifier.

ownerDisplayName.description: Public display name of the landlord.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the property was added to favorites.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest favorite or price-alert update.

TenantVerification.title: TenantVerification
TenantVerification.description: Non-PII tenant identity verification status record reviewed and approved by the Ejar project team.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the tenant.

tenantCategory.description: Tenant classification (family, university student, or corporate/industrial).

reviewNote.description: Optional note from the Ejar verification team.

TenantKycPrivate.title: TenantKycPrivate
TenantKycPrivate.description: Strictly isolated PII identity verification documents for tenants, readable only by the tenant or the verified Platform Admin.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the tenant.

fullLegalName.description: Quadruple Arabic legal name matching the National ID.

occupationOrUniversity.description: Employer, university & faculty (for students), or commercial registry.

idCardSha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of National ID file.

supportingDocFileName.description: Uploaded university ID, HR letter, or commercial register filename.

supportingDocSha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of supporting document.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of KYC private upload.

RentalRequest.title: RentalRequest
RentalRequest.description: Transparent pre-settlement rental request tracking approval, pending payment, escrow completion, or cancellation.

tenantId.description: Firebase Auth UID of requesting tenant.

tenantDisplayName.description: Public display name of requesting tenant.

landlordId.description: Firebase Auth UID of property landlord.

landlordDisplayName.description: Public display name of property landlord.

unitPriceEgp.description: Base rate per period in EGP.

unitsCount.description: Requested number of months or days (1 to 365).

bedsBooked.description: Requested number of student beds (0 when not student_bed).

commissionRatePct.description: Active one-time brokerage commission percentage at request creation.

exchangeRateToEgp.description: Optional exchange rate snapshot to EGP.

paidAmountInCurrency.description: Optional converted contract total in paymentCurrency.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the rental request.

statusNote.description: Human-readable explanation of current request status.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: User-scoped transparent rental request, contract status, and favorite price-drop notification with zero PII.

recipientId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the notification recipient.

actorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who triggered the status event.

actorDisplayName.description: Public display name of the triggering actor.

recipientRole.description: Role context in My Contracts panel.

statusType.description: Notification event category including favorite price-drop and chat unlock alerts.

relatedEntityType.description: Source entity type audited by relational security rules.

relatedEntityId.description: Document ID of the related rental request, booking, apartment, KYC, or favorite record.

apartmentTitle.description: Snapshot of property or verification title.

amountEgp.description: Associated contract, request, or new discounted rent amount in EGP.

message.description: Detailed status message explaining next steps.

isRead.description: Whether the recipient has marked the notification as read.

BannedUser.title: BannedUser
BannedUser.description: PII-free user ban record enforced in real time across user pages and Firestore security rules.

userId.description: Banned user UID or account identifier.

displayName.description: Public display name of the banned account (zero PII).

reason.description: Moderation reason for banning the account.

hideListings.description: Whether all listings and reviews from this user are hidden on public pages.

bannedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the platform admin who issued the ban.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the ban was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the ban was last updated.

AdminActivityLog.title: AdminActivityLog
AdminActivityLog.description: Immutable, PII-free administrative audit log tracking sensitive actions such as commission rate changes, user bans, listing removals, and moderation updates.

targetType.description: Entity type affected by the administrative action.

targetId.description: Identifier of the affected target entity.

targetLabel.description: Public, PII-free human-readable label of the affected target.

summaryAr.description: Arabic human-readable summary of the administrative action.

summaryEn.description: English human-readable summary of the administrative action.

previousValue.description: Snapshot of previous setting/status before the change.

newValue.description: Snapshot of new setting/status after the change.

actorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Platform Admin who performed the action.

actorDisplayName.description: Public display name of the Platform Admin (zero PII).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the audit log entry was recorded.

BookingDemandSignal.title: BookingDemandSignal
BookingDemandSignal.description: Zero-PII anonymized spatial demand signal derived atomically from completed rental contracts (status == 'completed') to power the public Egypt Governorate Residential Demand Heatmap.

bookingId.description: Source completed booking ID (1-to-1 with document ID).

unitsCount.description: Completed lease duration units count (1 to 365).

totalRentEgp.description: Total completed contract value in EGP.

ChatThread.title: ChatThread
ChatThread.description: Privacy-enforced tenant-landlord chat channel tracking anti-circumvention violation strikes and platform commission unlock status.

baseUnitPriceEgp.description: Base cycle rental rate in EGP used to compute commission unlock fee.

commissionRatePct.description: Active platform commission percentage for this category.

commissionAmountEgp.description: Required site brokerage commission in EGP to unlock full chat and phone reveal.

tenantId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the tenant.

tenantDisplayName.description: Public display name of the tenant.

landlordId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the landlord (or showcase_owner).

landlordDisplayName.description: Public display name of the landlord.

commissionPaid.description: Whether site brokerage commission has been paid to unlock phone exchange.

commissionPaymentMethod.description: Payment channel used for unlocking commission.

commissionPaidByUid.description: UID that settled the site commission.

commissionPaidAt.description: Server timestamp when site commission was settled.

bookingId.description: Optional associated booking ID if unlocked via full escrow.

tenantViolationCount.description: Number of blocked phone/contact sharing attempts by the tenant.

landlordViolationCount.description: Number of blocked phone/contact sharing attempts by the landlord.

lastViolationSenderId.description: UID of participant who triggered latest phone-bypass violation.

lastViolationReason.description: Summary of latest detected phone-bypass attempt (no phone digits stored).

lastMessagePreview.description: Safe preview of latest message (zero phone PII).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Immutable chat message between tenant and landlord protected by anti-phone-leak guards prior to commission settlement.

tenantId.description: Denormalized tenant UID for zero-get list security rules.

landlordId.description: Denormalized landlord UID for zero-get list security rules.

senderRole.description: Role of sender inside this thread.

isSystemNotice.description: Whether message is a platform status/unlock notice.

ChatContactExchange.title: ChatContactExchange
ChatContactExchange.description: Strictly PII-isolated verified Egyptian mobile numbers unlocked ONLY after platform commissionPaid == true.

userId.description: Owner UID of this contact record.

phoneNumber.description: Verified 11-digit Egyptian mobile number revealed strictly after commission settlement.

/platformSettings/{configId}.description: Singleton global platform configuration (/platformSettings/config) writable strictly by the verified Platform Admin.

/apartments/{apartmentId}.description: Publicly searchable multi-sector property listings without PII; deleted atomically upon rental or admin removal.

/apartments/{apartmentId}/legalDocs/{doc.description: Strictly isolated PII landlord ownership documents and brokerage mandate.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Escrow rental contracts enforcing the dynamic one-time brokerage commission and FX snapshot.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Public verified tenant reviews permanently tied to landlord accounts.

/favorites/{favoriteId}.description: Private user-scoped saved unit bookmarks with price-drop alert tracking readable and writable only by their owner.

/tenantVerifications/{userId}.description: Tenant identity verification status queue reviewed by the Ejar project team.

/tenantVerifications/{userId}/privateDoc.description: Strictly isolated PII tenant National ID and university/work credentials.

/rentalRequests/{requestId}.description: Rental requests tracking pending approval, awaiting payment, escrow approval, and cancellations.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Recipient-isolated rental request, contract lifecycle, and favorite price-drop notifications.

/bannedUsers/{userId}.description: PII-free banned user registry writable strictly by the verified Platform Admin and enforced across writes and public feeds.

/adminActivityLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable, append-only administrative activity log readable and creatable strictly by the verified Platform Admin (update/delete forbidden).

/bookingDemandSignals/{bookingId}.description: Zero-PII spatial demand signals verified against completed /bookings/{bookingId} documents for the public Egypt Residential Demand Heatmap.

/chatThreads/{threadId}.description: Participant-isolated tenant-landlord chat thread gated by platform brokerage commission payment.

/chatThreads/{threadId}/messages/{messag.description: Immutable chat messages with server-side anti-phone-leak enforcement prior to commission payment.

/chatThreads/{threadId}/contactExchange/.description: Strictly PII-isolated phone number vault readable by the counterparty only when parent thread commissionPaid == true.
